blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Require task markers before the proof gate can pass (factory/scripts/check_task_proof.py:128): The new proof check returns success when `added_markers()` is empty, so a task PR can omit its task marker entirely and avoid all verification, test, and review-evidence validation.

[P1] Do not trust a branch-controlled reconciled flag as proof (factory/scripts/check_task_proof.py:136): The proof gate skips every verification, test, and review check solely because a newly added JSON marker contains `reconciled: true`.

[P1] Verify the task delta exists on trunk before reconciling (factory/scripts/forge_cli/tasks.py:516): The reconcile command considers a task present on trunk when any one declared `write_scope` path exists there.

[P1] Reject a dirty index before reconcile commits evidence (factory/scripts/forge_cli/tasks.py:585): The reconcile flow stages its evidence files and then invokes a plain `git commit` without first requiring a clean index.

[P1] Bind degraded-mode waivers to the failed stage launch (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:1030): A required successful delegate launch is waived whenever any degraded-mode window started after the stage began.

[P1] Scope review-budget amendments beyond reusable task IDs (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:729): Protected scope amendments are retrieved only by `task_id`, while IDs such as `T1` are reused across stories.

[P1] Reconcile verifies only path existence, not that the task shipped (factory/scripts/forge_cli/tasks.py:520): The out-of-band reconciliation gate treats the task as shipped when any declared `write_scope` path merely exists on `origin/<trunk>`.

[P1] Scope amendment retroactively authorizes every out-of-scope edit (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:1526): `cmd_amend_scope` adds every currently changed out-of-scope product path to the effective scope based only on a caller-supplied reason.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Proof enforcement is optional via a PR-controlled marker (factory/scripts/check_task_proof.py:129): The gate succeeds whenever the PR omits a newly added `pr-ready.json`, even though direct/story-level PRs that omit this marker are the bypass the gate claims to close.

[P2] Bind recorded proof to the task and reviewed commit (factory/scripts/check_task_proof.py:86): `proof_problems` accepts story-scoped verify, test, and review artifacts based only on their success fields; it never checks their recorded commit, task identity, branch digest, or shared review-run identifier against the marker and current HEAD.

[P2] Unrelated degraded windows bypass required write-launch proof (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:1032): The launch exception accepts any active or completed degraded window whose timestamp is after the stage began.
